title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — November 08, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B7.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.3 (Peaked November 08, 2026 at 22:02 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.7 (Peaked November 08, 2026 at 07:46 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 710 km/s (Intense)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Active (Kp 4.00)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

The solar wind is in a hurry today. 💨🚀👀

Several bright active regions and a visible sunspot group stand out today; the coronagraph shows no clear CME.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
